# Scala Driver - (current)

> Explore resources and tutorials for using the MongoDB Scala Driver.

- [Configure Operations on Replica Sets](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/scala/scala-driver/current/read-write-pref.md): Configure replica set operations in the MongoDB Scala Driver, including read and write concerns, read preferences, and tag sets for targeted reads in Scala.
